- shot 3：核心功能 / 结构特写，展示关键结构、材质、开关、连接、形态或核心功能点。

【每个 shot 五项广告任务自查（Shot Task Checklist）】
每个 shot 必须同时满足以下五项任务；缺失任何一项意味着该 shot 需要重写：
1. 广告任务：该 shot 在整条广告叙事里承担什么功能（默认广告：Hook痛点 / 产品揭示 / 核心功能 / 使用演示 / 结果证明 / 轻转化；OOTD：穿搭Hook / 版型轮廓 / 穿着细节 / 场景氛围 / 动态证明 / 轻种草理由）？

3. 动作任务：visual_action 描述的动作是否单一、低风险、可生成？动作是否能被 Veo 在 8 秒内稳定完成？
4. 卖点/证明任务：该 shot 向观众传递了哪个具体卖点或提供了哪种可信证明（结构/材质/使用效果/数据/对比）？

- 如果产品有多个核心功能，必须将功能拆分到不同 shot，每个 shot 只做一个功能点，不堆叠。
- 功能拆解推荐顺序：外观/结构特写（shot 3）→ 单一核心功能演示（shot 3-4）→ 真实使用场景（shot 4）→ 效果结果证明（shot 5）。
- 禁止在同一 shot 的 visual_action 里描述多步骤、多动作或多功能同时展示。

- 优先低风险动作：单方向缓慢移动、轻柔触碰、单一弯折/伸缩到位后静止停顿、平移展示、静止特写。
- product_state 必须精确描述产品的物理状态（展开/收纳/弯曲/使用中/静止/结果状态），不得泛写"产品可见"。

【产品图视觉 Brief 传导约束（H1-fix-B）】
产品图片是最高优先级的产品事实来源，脚本必须严格服从产品图所示的真实形态：
- product_state 必须描述产品在产品图中可见的真实颜色、材质、结构、关键部件和使用状态，禁止凭空推断或泛写"产品可见"。
- 如果 product_visual_brief（产品视觉摘要）被注入，必须以此为基准约束所有 shot 的 product_state 和 visual_action。
- visual_action 中涉及的产品操作必须与产品图所示的实际结构一致：例如"弯折"仅适用于有柔性结构的产品，"旋转"仅适用于有旋钮的产品。
- 不得在脚本中发明产品图中不存在的颜色变种、功能按钮、材质或配件。
- 多图时，需综合所有产品图，不得以单张图片为唯一依据。

voice_localization._emotion_arc: Voiceover must follow an emotion arc across the 6 shots: (1) Hook急迫感 — 短促有力，直击痛点或制造好奇，1 句以内；(2) 解决方案期待 — 产品出现时语气转向"发现/找到/原来"，轻松中带惊喜；(3) 功能说明自信 — 平稳清晰地陈述一个功能事实，不夸张，像真实使用者分享；(4) 使用演示同步 — 口播与动作画面完全同步，短句直接，有现场感；(5) 结果惊喜 — 语气转为满意/惊讶，可用感叹语气，但保持真实感，不做广告腔；(6) 可信推荐/轻 CTA — 自然推荐感，像朋友真诚分享，不说"立即购买"等硬广口号。

execution_layer.first_frame_obedience: Always use the provided storyboard panel image as the exact first frame. Do not re-create, reinterpret, or replace the first frame. The first 1-2 seconds of the clip must start the key visual action or selling-point proof visible in the first frame — no empty posing, no slow zoom-in, no slow fade-in from black.
execution_layer.ad_task_density: Each 8-second clip must complete exactly one clear TikTok ad task: pain-point exposure, product reveal, feature proof, usage demonstration, result evidence, or soft conversion. Clips that show no clear ad task or simply repeat the first frame in a slow loop are rejected.
execution_layer.product_function_low_risk: Product function execution must use only low穿模-risk motions: single-direction slow movement, gentle touch, single bend/extend to a held position, pan/tilt reveal, still close-up. Never execute: complex finger manipulation, rapid mechanical motion, multi-part assembly/disassembly, fast product shape change, or multi-object complex interaction.
execution_layer.script_obedience: Veo must faithfully execute the confirmed script shot — visual_action, camera_movement, product_state. Do not invent new plot, new props, new characters, new product functions, or new scenes not in the script. Do not let story, mood, background, or actor performance override exact product identity.
execution_layer.ootd_style_showcase: When the confirmed script is OOTD / outfit / fit check / lookbook / 穿搭 / 上身 / 风格展示, execute it as style-first outfit content, not pain-point education. Preserve same model, same face, same hairstyle, same body proportions, same outfit, exact garment cut/color/material/hemline/neckline/waistline/opacity from the first frame and product references. Use subtle walk, pause, turn, smile, on-body detail, and natural lifestyle motion; no hanger-only shot, no outfit change, no garment redesign, no fabric warping.
execution_layer.clip_8s_structure: Every video prompt must treat the current storyboard panel as one independent 8-second clip: first 1-2 seconds start the strongest hook/action from the first frame; middle 3-6 seconds complete exactly one simple action, proof, use, reveal, or style movement; last 7-8 seconds hold a stable ending frame with product readable and character/product identity stable. No slow buildup, no empty lingering, no repeated posing, no second action stack.
execution_layer.product_display_showcase: For product display clips, execute one clear selling-point proof per 8 seconds: complete product reveal, structure/material detail, single real-use action, visible result, or soft recommendation. Keep product complete/readable when it is the subject; do not invent functions or drift into catalog beauty shots.
execution_layer.apparel_product_display: For apparel product display, show the exact garment SKU through full worn view, front/side silhouette, on-body detail, real-life styling, or subtle movement. Preserve neckline, waistline, hemline, length, cut, material, opacity, color, drape, and wearing style. No hanger-only sequence, no model/face/body change, no garment redesign.
execution_layer.unboxing_showcase: For unboxing clips, keep packaging and product identity grounded in uploaded references. Use one simple hand action only: hold, open, lift, reveal, touch detail, place product. Do not invent packaging text, labels, accessories, logo marks, or extra items. End with product clearly visible.
execution_layer.pain_point_showcase: For pain-point clips, the pain/conflict must be visible immediately and directly related to the product. Product enters as a natural solution in the correct shot; do not use pain framing for OOTD, apparel product display, unboxing, or ordinary product showcase unless explicitly requested.
